visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide aerial shot of a rolling mountain slope completely covered in white plum blossoms, resembling a blanket of snow. A winding brown path cuts through the dense white trees. (2) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a light blue shirt under a pink vest and tan shorts, walks away from the camera on a grassy trail surrounded by gnarled plum trees heavy with white blooms. The setting is bright with natural daylight and lush green grass. (3) A close-up shot shows delicate white petals with yellow centers against dark, bare branches. Small petals drift through the air like snow. The woman is seen twirling joyfully, her hair swinging, while smiling at the camera. (4) Another high-angle aerial view shows the vast scale of the plum forest in Nantou, with a winding road snaking through the white-covered hills. Yellow and white variety-style captions are centered on the frame. (5) The woman and a young man in a blue jacket are seated together on a grassy slope beneath a large blooming plum tree. They hold a smartphone and point towards the scenery, surrounded by scattered white petals on the grass. (6) The camera performs a rapid zoom-out from the couple, revealing the immense expanse of the white plum blossom sea across the entire mountain ridge under a soft, overcast sky.
